boons.name: Gullwind
boons.description: A following wind that smells of feathers. Your hulls run faster.

boons.name: Otter's Grace
boons.description: Forgiveness in the turn. The first buoy you miss in a slalom costs you nothing.

boons.name: Pearl Sense
boons.description: You feel the weight of sunken things. Dives yield more salvage.

boons.name: Deep Lungs
boons.description: The cold stops arguing with your chest. Longer breath underwater.

boons.name: Storm Soul
boons.description: You stop flinching at thunder. Squalls do less harm to your hull.

boons.name: Barnacle Hide
boons.description: The hull grows a stubborn crust. Maximum hull increased by two.

boons.name: Tide's Favor
boons.description: The sea tips its hand toward you. All salvage gains increased.

boons.name: Mirror Calm
boons.description: Once, when everything goes wrong, it simply will not have happened.

boons.name: Line Singer
boons.description: Fishing line hums in your hands like a tuned string. Fish fight fair.

boons.name: Wake Reader
boons.description: You read the water two beats ahead. Race and slalom cues come earlier.

boons.name: Lifeline
boons.description: Someone below is watching out for you. Rescues go smoother.

boons.name: Mark of the Undertow
boons.description: A cold brand on the wrist that aches near deep water. Salvage and renown flow to you, and the sea watches with interest.

boons.name: Drowned Chorus
boons.description: Voices under the hull sing the hazards before they arrive. All contests come easier.

boons.name: Lantern's Eye
boons.description: The lighthouse beam follows you out past where it should reach. Hull damage from any source is softened.
